title: Presence — Attendance Platform
shortDescription: Cross-platform mobile attendance and notice platform with BLE proximity and facial liveness verification.

description.overview: A mobile digital attendance and notice distribution platform built with separated Student and Teacher modules. It eliminates proxy check-ins using a dual-factor verification pipeline.
description.architecture: When a teacher starts an attendance session, the student app validates Bluetooth Low Energy (BLE) signal proximity and performs active facial liveness verification against a Django REST Framework backend hosted on AWS EC2.
outcomes: Eliminated proxy attendance via combined BLE hardware handshakes and facial recognition.
Separated teacher session controls and student views into isolated role-based screens.
Automated .xlsx attendance sheet generation directly from PostgreSQL.

title: Desktop POS & Inventory System
shortDescription: Offline-first desktop billing and inventory management application running on a local client-server architecture.

description.overview: A fully offline desktop point-of-sale and inventory tracking system engineered for fast retail billing, USB barcode scanning, and thermal receipt printing.
description.architecture: Uses an Electron + React frontend communicating locally with a background Python (Flask) server and SQLite relational database, ensuring zero-downtime operation without internet dependency.
outcomes: Deployed in active daily production at a local retail store.
Integrated 2D USB barcode scanner workflows and instant thermal receipt generation.
Maintained local ACID transaction integrity across inventory and billing tables.

images.caption: Local SQLite Inventory & Stock Alert Manager

demoVideo.caption: Live barcode scanning and thermal receipt printing demonstration.

title: College Timetable Generator
shortDescription: Constraint-based academic schedule generator powered by Google OR-Tools CP-SAT and bulk Excel ingestion.

description.overview: An automated academic timetable scheduler that resolves multi-department course, room, and faculty conflicts using mathematical constraint programming.
description.architecture: Combines a Next.js tabular constraint input interface and .xlsx parser with a Django + PostgreSQL backend that dispatches scheduling jobs to a Google OR-Tools CP-SAT solver.
outcomes: Modeled continuous multi-hour practical lab blocks and faculty workload constraints in CP-SAT.
Built a split-screen configuration UI alongside bulk .xlsx spreadsheet ingestion.
Persisted generated schedules and constraint presets in PostgreSQL.

images.caption: Tabular Constraint Input & Faculty Assignment Split View

demoVideo.caption: Uploading an institutional .xlsx file and solving constraints in real time.

title: Multi-AMR Fleet & Live Telemetry
shortDescription: Decentralized multi-robot collision avoidance system with a Flask Socket.IO telemetry backend and React map UI.

description.overview: Built for Smart India Hackathon 2026, this system coordinates multiple Autonomous Mobile Robots (AMRs) without a central single point of failure while streaming live fleet diagnostics to a web dashboard.
description.architecture: Robots negotiate trajectories peer-to-peer in ROS 2 and Gazebo while a Python Flask + Socket.IO server broadcasts real-time position, path, and battery telemetry to a React map interface.
outcomes: Implemented decentralized path planning and collision avoidance across multiple simulated AMRs.
Engineered a low-latency WebSocket telemetry pipeline streaming coordinates and battery states.
Built an interactive React dashboard to monitor live robot trajectories.

images.caption: React Live Map Dashboard Receiving Socket.IO Telemetry

demoVideo.caption: Multi-AMR peer-to-peer path negotiation and live React dashboard telemetry.

title: Lunar Surface Boulder Detection
shortDescription: YOLO computer vision pipeline trained on orbital imagery to detect lunar boulders for the ISRO Hackathon.

description.overview: Developed during the ISRO Bharatiya Antariksh Hackathon to automatically identify boulders and terrain hazards on the lunar surface from high-resolution orbital imagery.
description.architecture: Built a custom data annotation and preprocessing pipeline for low-contrast satellite imagery and fine-tuned YOLO object detection weights for small-crater and boulder localization.
outcomes: Curated and labeled a custom lunar surface boulder dataset from orbital imagery.
Tuned YOLO detection thresholds to handle harsh lunar shadow gradients.

images.caption: YOLO Bounding Box Predictions on Lunar Crater Imagery

title: Haazirhu — Dual-Portal Platform
shortDescription: Quick-commerce and booking web application featuring a customer storefront and real-time Firebase admin dashboard.

description.overview: A dual-portal web platform pairing a customer ordering interface with a dedicated admin dashboard for processing and fulfilling live orders.
description.architecture: Built with React and Vite on the frontend and powered by Firebase Authentication and real-time Cloud Firestore listeners for instant order status synchronization.
outcomes: Built separate customer and admin portals backed by Firebase role-based authentication.
Synchronized live order state updates across clients without manual page refreshes.
